title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Household Waste Recycling Rates
prompt: The table below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in four different countries (A, B, C and D) in the years 2005, 2010 and 2015. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景和数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请根据表格中的信息，总结主要特征并进行比较。注意：不要表达个人观点或解释原因；确保字数不少于150词；所有必要数据均已在表格中给出。
